# anthropic_agent (Data Source)

Get information about a single Managed Agent by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_agent" "example" {
  id = "agent_xxxxx"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the Agent.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the Agent.
- `mcp_servers` (Attributes List) MCP servers configured on the Agent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mcp_servers))
- `metadata` (Map of String) Arbitrary key-value metadata attached to the Agent.
- `model` (String) Model ID of the Agent.
- `name` (String) Name of the Agent.
- `skills` (Attributes List) Skills attached to the Agent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--skills))
- `system` (String) System prompt of the Agent.
- `tools` (Attributes List) Toolsets configured on the Agent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tools))
- `version` (String) Version of the Agent.

<a id="nestedatt--mcp_servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mcp_servers`

Read-Only:

- `configs` (Attributes List) Per-tool overrides within the toolset. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mcp_servers--configs))
- `default_config` (Attributes) Default configuration applied to the toolset. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mcp_servers--default_config))
- `name` (String) Name of the MCP server.
- `type` (String) Type of the MCP server.
- `url` (String) URL of the MCP server.

Read-Only:
